evidence.translation: Leaving the village toward the cacti, go straight and find the first passage

facts.subject: Chapter 5 cacti area
facts.text: According to a community comment, the Chapter 5 cacti area has 4 secret passages in addition to the main entrance.

evidence.quote: so 4 secretas + a entrada principal
evidence.translation: only 4 secret ones + the main entrance

facts.subject: Heart Container in Chapter 6
facts.text: After leaving the ship, walk to the mountain without entering the city, then go straight until you enter inside the mountain.

evidence.quote: depois de descer da nave caminhe para a montanha no entre na cidade, siga reto at entrar dentro da montanha
evidence.translation: After getting off the ship, walk to the mountain, do not enter the city, go straight until you enter inside the mountain
